          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/surviving_mars/better_fuel.json",
          "text": "Fuel is hard to get; it requires venturing out to the ocean, looking for oil spouts. The Cryo Freezer introduces a new way to obtain a better fuel - Cryo Fuel. Cryo Fuel is much more efficient than refined fuel, allowing you to launch a rocket with just one bucket.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.0.text",
          "label": "Better Fuel",
          "item_ref_count": 5,
          "recipe_ref_count": 1,
          "count": 4
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/surviving_mars/better_fuel",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/surviving_mars/better_fuel.json",
          "text": "It's created by collecting ice shards, which are found as an ore underground on cold planets. The ice shard then needs to be inserted into a Cryo Freezer, and it will convert to 25 mB of Cryo Fuel. Alternatively, you can convert ice, packed ice and blue ice to fuel. Once you've made at least two buckets (one for a launch and the other for a return trip), place the buckets in the rocket fuel slot.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.1.text",
          "label": "Better Fuel",
          "item_ref_count": 5,
          "recipe_ref_count": 1,
          "count": 4
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/surviving_mars/better_fuel",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/surviving_mars/better_fuel.json",
          "text": "Cryo Fuel",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.3.title",
          "label": "Better Fuel",
          "item_ref_count": 5,
          "recipe_ref_count": 1,
          "count": 4
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/surviving_mars/better_fuel",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/surviving_mars/better_fuel.json",
          "text": "In addition to being an excellent fuel, cryo fuel has some other features. When placed, it will damage anything inside, similar to lava. It also freezes water, allowing for an infinite ice source.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.3.text",
          "label": "Better Fuel",
          "item_ref_count": 5,
          "recipe_ref_count": 1,
          "count": 4
        },
        {

          "key": "guide-page:pages.0.title",
          "label": "Detection",
          "item_ref_count": 3,
          "recipe_ref_count": 1,
          "count": 2
        },
        {

          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/surviving_mars/detection.json",
          "text": "The oxygen sensor is a block that will emit a redstone signal when it detects oxygen. You can shift-right-click it to invert the signal. Despite its name, you can also change its detection type by right-clicking with a wrench. It has the option to detect oxygen, safe temperature, and normal gravity.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.0.text",
          "label": "Detection",
          "item_ref_count": 3,
          "recipe_ref_count": 1,
          "count": 2
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/surviving_mars/energizer",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/surviving_mars/energizer.json",
          "text": "The energizer is a machine capable of powering items and storing large amounts of energy. To charge an item, power the energizer and then right-click on the energizer with that item. It stores 2 million energy, making it capable of charging machines for a very long time. It also retains its energy when broken.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.0.text",
          "label": "Energizer",
          "item_ref_count": 3,
          "recipe_ref_count": 1,
          "count": 2
        },

          "kind": "guide_page",

          "text": "Flags are decorative blocks available in 16 colors. By default, when placed, they will display the face of the flag owner.       "semantic_evidence": [
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/anvil_working_guide",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/anvil_working_guide.json",
          "text": "Anvil Working Guide",
          "key": "guide-page:name",
          "label": "Anvil Working Guide",
          "item_ref_count": 17,
          "count": 30
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/anvil_working_guide",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/anvil_working_guide.json",
          "text": "Working with Anvils",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.0.title",
          "label": "Anvil Working Guide",
          "item_ref_count": 17,
          "count": 30
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/anvil_working_guide",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/anvil_working_guide.json",
          "text": "Working in Anvils is a key process inside TerraFirmaGreg, as most of your work towards the Steam and Mechanical ages will require the usage of an Anvil. This guide is broken down into two parts, Understanding the UI and How to Perfectly Forge. The Modpack has a custom Resource Pack called TFC Anvil Helper that you need to enable for this guide to make sense.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.0.text",
          "label": "Anvil Working Guide",
          "item_ref_count": 17,
          "count": 30
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/anvil_working_guide",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/anvil_working_guide.json",
          "text": "The UI for the Anvil with TFC Anvil Helper Enabled",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.1.text",
          "label": "Anvil Working Guide",
          "item_ref_count": 17,
          "count": 30
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/anvil_working_guide",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/anvil_working_guide.json",
          "text": "The UI for the Anvil with TFC Anvil Helper Enabled, Color Coded.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.2.text",
          "label": "Anvil Working Guide",
          "item_ref_count": 17,
          "count": 30
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/anvil_working_guide",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/anvil_working_guide.json",
          "text": "1. The item you've selected to Create in the Anvil. Each item has a specific set of required Steps and Work Amount 2. The Input item you're currently working. 3. The required Steps in Order that must be completed before the Item is considered complete. There are a total of 4 different Orders (See next Page):",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.3.text",
          "label": "Anvil Working Guide",
          "item_ref_count": 17,
          "count": 30
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/anvil_working_guide",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/anvil_working_guide.json",
          "text": "(Note: X is a wild-card for any kind of Step) - x_Any: Step can occurr in any of the last 3 actions. - x_Last: Must be the last step performed. - x_Not Last: The Step cannot be the Last Step performed. - x_Second Last: Must be the Second to Last step performed. - x_Third Last: Must be the Third to Last step performed",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.5.text",
          "label": "Anvil Working Guide",
          "item_ref_count": 17,
          "count": 30
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/anvil_working_guide",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/anvil_working_guide.json",
          "text": "4. The types of Steps. Each type of step Subtracts or Adds to the current Work value. These are, in order from Left to Right, Top to Bottom: - Light Hit: -3 - Medium Hit: -6 - Punch: +2 - Bend: +7 - Hard Hit: -9 - Draw: -15 - Upset: +13 - Shrink: +16",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.7.text",
          "label": "Anvil Working Guide",
          "item_ref_count": 17,
          "count": 30
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/anvil_working_guide",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/anvil_working_guide.json",
          "text": "5. The Slots where your Hammer goes, and Flux if youre Welding. 6. The current Work amount the item has, Doing different Steps either Increases or Decreases the amount of Work the item has. 7. The Target Work value, the Work value must be aligned EXACTLY with the Target Work, AND the Required Steps must be fulfilled for the Item to be considered complete. 8. The Work Bar, used for Aligning the Work value with the Target Work value.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.9.text",
          "label": "Anvil Working Guide",
          "item_ref_count": 17,
          "count": 30
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/anvil_working_guide",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/anvil_working_guide.json",
          "text": "How to Perfectly Forge",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.10.title",
          "label": "Anvil Working Guide",
          "item_ref_count": 17,
          "count": 30
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/anvil_working_guide",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/anvil_working_guide.json",
          "text": "Perfectly Forging an Item which can break, such as Tool Heads, Weapons, and Armor causes the Item to gain bonuses to it's durability and general efficiency with the less total steps you take to forge the Item. Completing the Work on an Item with very few steps causes it to be Perfectly Forged, not only giving your finished item bonuses, but also reducing the overall wear and tear to the Hammer.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.10.text",
          "label": "Anvil Working Guide",
          "item_ref_count": 17,
          "count": 30
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/anvil_working_guide",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/anvil_working_guide.json",
          "text": "A Perfectly Forged Wrought Iron Pickaxe Head",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.11.text",
          "label": "Anvil Working Guide",
          "item_ref_count": 17,
          "count": 30
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/anvil_working_guide",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/anvil_working_guide.json",
          "text": "Guide to Forging",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.12.title",
          "label": "Anvil Working Guide",
          "item_ref_count": 17,
          "count": 30
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/anvil_working_guide",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/anvil_working_guide.json",
          "text": "This part of the guide will cover how to Perfectly Forge anything, starting with a Wrought Iron Pickaxe Head. DISCLAIMER: While the Required Steps and Orders for an Item are universal within all worlds in TerraFirmaGreg, the Target Work value differs because its derived from your world's Seed, as such, this Guide ASSUMES the Target Work value for the Wrought Iron Pickaxe Head is 83",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.12.text",
          "label": "Anvil Working Guide",
          "item_ref_count": 17,
          "count": 30
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/anvil_working_guide",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/anvil_working_guide.json",
          "text": "Step 1",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.14.title",
          "label": "Anvil Working Guide",
          "item_ref_count": 17,
          "count": 30
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/anvil_working_guide",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/anvil_working_guide.json",
          "text": "The first Step in your Forging Journey is to get the Value taken by Adding all of the Required Step's values together. For a Pickaxe Head, you need the following Steps: - Punch Last - Bend Not Last - Draw Not Last. By adding the Values on the Bottom of each Step, We get the Value we're looking for. Lets call this value \"requiredWork\". 2 + 7 + (-15) = -6",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.14.text",
          "label": "Anvil Working Guide",
          "item_ref_count": 17,
          "count": 30
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/anvil_working_guide",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/anvil_working_guide.json",
          "text": "The steps required for a Pickaxe",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.15.text",
          "label": "Anvil Working Guide",
          "item_ref_count": 17,
          "count": 30
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/anvil_working_guide",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/anvil_working_guide.json",
          "text": "Step 2",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.16.title",
          "label": "Anvil Working Guide",
          "item_ref_count": 17,
          "count": 30
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/anvil_working_guide",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/anvil_working_guide.json",
          "text": "While our main goal for the Work Amount is to align it with the Target Work, we need to make sure both that requirement AND the Steps requirements are fulfilled, as such, directly aligning the Work Amount with the Target Work will not yield desirable results. Instead, we can calculate the a value derived from Target Work and \"requiredWork\"",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.16.text",
          "label": "Anvil Working Guide",
          "item_ref_count": 17,
          "count": 30
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/anvil_working_guide",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/anvil_working_guide.json",
          "text": "This value can be obtained depending on the Sign of \"requiredWork\" (IE: if the value is Negative or Positive). - If \"requiredWork\" is PositiveSubtract \"requiredWork\"'s Absolute Value from \"Target Work\"83 - 6 == 77 - If \"requiredWork\" is NegativeAdd \"requiredWork\"'s Absolute Value to \"Target Work\"83 + 6 = 89",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.17.text",
          "label": "Anvil Working Guide",
          "item_ref_count": 17,
          "count": 30
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/anvil_working_guide",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/anvil_working_guide.json",
          "text": "Since the \"requiredWork\" for our item is -6, the value we're looking for is 89. You may be wondering, how can you get exact numerical values for your Target Work? Well, the Anvil UI shows us with the Work Bar. It only shows the multiples of 20, but we can know the other numbers easily via the colored lines: - Light Gray: Represents a multiple of 5 - Gray: Represents an Odd Number - Dark Gray: Represents an Even Number",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.18.text",
          "label": "Anvil Working Guide",
          "item_ref_count": 17,
          "count": 30
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/anvil_working_guide",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/anvil_working_guide.json",
          "text": "Step 3",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.20.title",
          "label": "Anvil Working Guide",
          "item_ref_count": 17,
          "count": 30
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/anvil_working_guide",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/anvil_working_guide.json",
          "text": "With the value derived from \"Target Work\" and \"requiredWork\", we now need to reach said Work value, this can be done either manually by adding the numbers attached for each step, or by using the cheat sheet in the UI bar. Each color represents the Step Type in the UI. IE: Red == Shrink (+16)",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.20.text",
          "label": "Anvil Working Guide",
          "item_ref_count": 17,
          "count": 30
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/anvil_working_guide",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/anvil_working_guide.json",
          "text": "16 + 16 + 16 + 16 + 16 + 7 + 2 = 89",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.21.text",
          "label": "Anvil Working Guide",
          "item_ref_count": 17,
          "count": 30
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/anvil_working_guide",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/anvil_working_guide.json",
          "text": "Step 4",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.22.title",
          "label": "Anvil Working Guide",
          "item_ref_count": 17,
          "count": 30
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/anvil_working_guide",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/anvil_working_guide.json",
          "text": "Now that we know the required steps, its time to reach the Value derived from \"Target Work\" and \"requiredWork\". For a pickaxe head where it's TotalWork value is 83, we need to reach 89. As such, we do: (Shrink x 5) -> Bend -> Punch. Once our Work value is at our desired value, just follow the Required Steps, which for a pickaxe head its: Draw -> Bend -> Punch. And Voila! We've obtained a Perfectly Forged Item!",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.22.text",
          "label": "Anvil Working Guide",
          "item_ref_count": 17,
          "count": 30
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/anvil_working_guide",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/anvil_working_guide.json",
          "text": "An Ingot with No Work->Desired Work Value Reached->Doing the Required Steps for our Item.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.23.text",
          "label": "Anvil Working Guide",
          "item_ref_count": 17,
          "count": 30
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/anvil_working_guide",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/anvil_working_guide.json",
          "text": "Lets see this process with other items, such as a Plate, or a Rod. Again, the Target Work differs by the world seed, so their values will be different on your world. Plate Target Value: 111 Required Steps: Hit x 3, Any Order. \"requiredWork\": -3 x 3 = -9 Derived Value: 111 + 9 = 120. Reaching the Value: (Shrink x 5)->(Upset x 2)->(Punch x 2) Getting the Item: 120 - (Light Hit x 3) == 111. Both requirements met.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.24.text",
          "label": "Anvil Working Guide",
          "item_ref_count": 17,
          "count": 30
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/anvil_working_guide",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/anvil_working_guide.json",
          "text": "Rod Target Value: 78 Required Steps: Draw->Draw->Bend \"requiredWork\": (-15 x 2) + 7 = -23 Derived Value: 78 + 23 = 101. Reaching the Value: (Shrink x 5)->(Bend x 3) Getting the Item: 101 - 15 - 15 + 7 = 78.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.25.text",
          "label": "Anvil Working Guide",
          "item_ref_count": 17,
          "count": 30
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/anvil_working_guide",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/anvil_working_guide.json",
          "text": "Other Tidbits",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.26.title",
          "label": "Anvil Working Guide",
          "item_ref_count": 17,
          "count": 30
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/anvil_working_guide",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/anvil_working_guide.json",
          "text": "If one of the Required Steps is Empty, it means it's a Wild Card, any Step can be used. If you fail your calculations, you can always melt and cast your item back into an ingot, this will remove the \"worked\" tag for the item, letting you try again to perfectly forge it.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.26.text",
          "label": "Anvil Working Guide",
          "item_ref_count": 17,
          "count": 30
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/anvil_working_guide",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/anvil_working_guide.json",
          "text": "Congratulations on Reaching the End, if youre a contributor looking to re-take the pictures in this guide, the seed used during it's writing is -7291708953208913102, You could also create a creative world to test the algorithm yourself! Also... since you're here, if you cant be bothered to do all the calculations yourself, you can always use the TFC Anvil Calculator...",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.29.text",
          "label": "Anvil Working Guide",
          "item_ref_count": 17,
          "count": 30
        },
        {

        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/beneath/beneath_wild_fruits",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/beneath/beneath_wild_fruits.json",
          "text": "Beneath Wild Fruits",
          "key": "guide-page:name",
          "label": "Beneath Wild Fruits",
          "item_ref_count": 6,
          "count": 8
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/beneath/beneath_wild_fruits",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/beneath/beneath_wild_fruits.json",
          "text": "The Beneath hosts its own unique selection of wild fruits, which have adapted to the extreme conditions underground. Wild fruits can be cultivated in all the same ways as regular wild fruits in the Overworld.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.0.text",
          "label": "Beneath Wild Fruits",
          "item_ref_count": 6,
          "count": 8
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/beneath/beneath_wild_fruits",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/beneath/beneath_wild_fruits.json",
          "text": "- Lavacado - Magmango",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.1.text",
          "label": "Beneath Wild Fruits",
          "item_ref_count": 6,
          "count": 8
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/beneath/beneath_wild_fruits",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/beneath/beneath_wild_fruits.json",
          "text": "Temperature: 8 - 80 °C Hydration: 20 - 100 % Lavacado trees grow in the months of December through April, start flowering in May and June, and bear fruit in July.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.2.text",
          "label": "Beneath Wild Fruits",
          "item_ref_count": 6,
          "count": 8
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/beneath/beneath_wild_fruits",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/beneath/beneath_wild_fruits.json",
          "text": "An example lavacado tree.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.3.text",
          "label": "Beneath Wild Fruits",
          "item_ref_count": 6,
          "count": 8
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/beneath/beneath_wild_fruits",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/beneath/beneath_wild_fruits.json",
          "text": "Temperature: 8 - 80 °C Hydration: 30 - 100 % Magmango trees grow in the months of October through February, start flowering in March and April, and bear fruit in May.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.4.text",
          "label": "Beneath Wild Fruits",
          "item_ref_count": 6,
          "count": 8
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/beneath/beneath_wild_fruits",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/beneath/beneath_wild_fruits.json",
          "text": "An example magmango tree.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.5.text",
          "label": "Beneath Wild Fruits",
          "item_ref_count": 6,
          "count": 8
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/beneath/beneath_wild_fruits",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/beneath/beneath_wild_fruits.json",
          "text": "The fruiting calendar for fruit trees.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.6.text",
          "label": "Beneath Wild Fruits",
          "item_ref_count": 6,
          "count": 8
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/beneath/beneath_wild_fruits",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/beneath/beneath_wild_fruits.json",
          "text": "Fruit Trees",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.6.title",
          "label": "Beneath Wild Fruits",
          "item_ref_count": 6,
          "count": 8
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/firmaciv/arborfirmacraft",
          "source": "jar:firmacivplus-1.0.1-1.20.1.jar!assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/firmaciv/arborfirmacraft.json",
          "text": "If you see Tualang or Fig trees in your travels, you'll be pleased to know that you'll be able to create Boats with them just like any other kind of Wood",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.0.text",
          "label": "ArborFirmaCraft",
          "item_ref_count": 6,
          "count": 6
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/firmaciv/arborfirmacraft",
          "source": "jar:firmacivplus-1.0.1-1.20.1.jar!assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/firmaciv/arborfirmacraft.json",
          "text": "Softwoods have sufficiently soft enough pulp and bark that they're perfect for creating Dugout Canoes",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.2.text",
          "label": "ArborFirmaCraft",
          "item_ref_count": 6,
          "count": 6
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/firmaciv/arborfirmacraft",
          "source": "jar:firmacivplus-1.0.1-1.20.1.jar!assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/firmaciv/arborfirmacraft.json",
          "text": "- Tualang - Fig - Cypress",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.3.text",
          "label": "ArborFirmaCraft",
          "item_ref_count": 6,
          "count": 6
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/firmaciv/arborfirmacraft",
          "source": "jar:firmacivplus-1.0.1-1.20.1.jar!assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/firmaciv/arborfirmacraft.json",
          "text": "Known for their exceptional sturdiness, Hardwood trees are ideal for creating larger and sophisticated Watercrafts such as Rowboats and Sloops",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.4.text",

        {
          "kind": "guide_page",

        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/anvil_working_guide",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/anvil_working_guide.json",
          "text": "Working with Anvils",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.0.title",
          "label": "Anvil Working Guide",
          "item_ref_count": 17,
          "count": 30
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/anvil_working_guide",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/anvil_working_guide.json",
          "text": "Working in Anvils is a key process inside TerraFirmaGreg, as most of your work towards the Steam and Mechanical ages will require the usage of an Anvil. This guide is broken down into two parts, Understanding the UI and How to Perfectly Forge. The Modpack has a custom Resource Pack called TFC Anvil Helper that you need to enable for this guide to make sense.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.0.text",
          "label": "Anvil Working Guide",
          "item_ref_count": 17,
          "count": 30
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/anvil_working_guide",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/anvil_working_guide.json",
          "text": "The UI for the Anvil with TFC Anvil Helper Enabled",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.1.text",
          "label": "Anvil Working Guide",
          "item_ref_count": 17,
          "count": 30
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/anvil_working_guide",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/anvil_working_guide.json",
          "text": "The UI for the Anvil with TFC Anvil Helper Enabled, Color Coded.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.2.text",
          "label": "Anvil Working Guide",
          "item_ref_count": 17,
          "count": 30
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/anvil_working_guide",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/anvil_working_guide.json",
          "text": "1. The item you've selected to Create in the Anvil. Each item has a specific set of required Steps and Work Amount 2. The Input item you're currently working. 3. The required Steps in Order that must be completed before the Item is considered complete. There are a total of 4 different Orders (See next Page):",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.3.text",
          "label": "Anvil Working Guide",
          "item_ref_count": 17,
          "count": 30
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/anvil_working_guide",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/anvil_working_guide.json",
          "text": "(Note: X is a wild-card for any kind of Step) - x_Any: Step can occurr in any of the last 3 actions. - x_Last: Must be the last step performed. - x_Not Last: The Step cannot be the Last Step performed. - x_Second Last: Must be the Second to Last step performed. - x_Third Last: Must be the Third to Last step performed",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.5.text",
          "label": "Anvil Working Guide",
          "item_ref_count": 17,
          "count": 30
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/anvil_working_guide",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/anvil_working_guide.json",
          "text": "4. The types of Steps. Each type of step Subtracts or Adds to the current Work value. These are, in order from Left to Right, Top to Bottom: - Light Hit: -3 - Medium Hit: -6 - Punch: +2 - Bend: +7 - Hard Hit: -9 - Draw: -15 - Upset: +13 - Shrink: +16",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.7.text",
          "label": "Anvil Working Guide",
          "item_ref_count": 17,
          "count": 30
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/anvil_working_guide",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/anvil_working_guide.json",
          "text": "5. The Slots where your Hammer goes, and Flux if youre Welding. 6. The current Work amount the item has, Doing different Steps either Increases or Decreases the amount of Work the item has. 7. The Target Work value, the Work value must be aligned EXACTLY with the Target Work, AND the Required Steps must be fulfilled for the Item to be considered complete. 8. The Work Bar, used for Aligning the Work value with the Target Work value.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.9.text",
          "label": "Anvil Working Guide",
          "item_ref_count": 17,
          "count": 30
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/anvil_working_guide",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/anvil_working_guide.json",
          "text": "How to Perfectly Forge",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.10.title",
          "label": "Anvil Working Guide",
          "item_ref_count": 17,
          "count": 30
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/anvil_working_guide",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/anvil_working_guide.json",
          "text": "Perfectly Forging an Item which can break, such as Tool Heads, Weapons, and Armor causes the Item to gain bonuses to it's durability and general efficiency with the less total steps you take to forge the Item. Completing the Work on an Item with very few steps causes it to be Perfectly Forged, not only giving your finished item bonuses, but also reducing the overall wear and tear to the Hammer.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.10.text",
          "label": "Anvil Working Guide",
          "item_ref_count": 17,
          "count": 30
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/anvil_working_guide",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/anvil_working_guide.json",
          "text": "A Perfectly Forged Wrought Iron Pickaxe Head",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.11.text",
          "label": "Anvil Working Guide",
          "item_ref_count": 17,
          "count": 30
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/anvil_working_guide",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/anvil_working_guide.json",
          "text": "Guide to Forging",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.12.title",
          "label": "Anvil Working Guide",
          "item_ref_count": 17,
          "count": 30
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/anvil_working_guide",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/anvil_working_guide.json",
          "text": "This part of the guide will cover how to Perfectly Forge anything, starting with a Wrought Iron Pickaxe Head. DISCLAIMER: While the Required Steps and Orders for an Item are universal within all worlds in TerraFirmaGreg, the Target Work value differs because its derived from your world's Seed, as such, this Guide ASSUMES the Target Work value for the Wrought Iron Pickaxe Head is 83",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.12.text",
          "label": "Anvil Working Guide",
          "item_ref_count": 17,
          "count": 30
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/anvil_working_guide",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/anvil_working_guide.json",
          "text": "Step 1",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.14.title",
          "label": "Anvil Working Guide",
          "item_ref_count": 17,
          "count": 30
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/anvil_working_guide",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/anvil_working_guide.json",
          "text": "The first Step in your Forging Journey is to get the Value taken by Adding all of the Required Step's values together. For a Pickaxe Head, you need the following Steps: - Punch Last - Bend Not Last - Draw Not Last. By adding the Values on the Bottom of each Step, We get the Value we're looking for. Lets call this value \"requiredWork\". 2 + 7 + (-15) = -6",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.14.text",
          "label": "Anvil Working Guide",
          "item_ref_count": 17,
          "count": 30
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/anvil_working_guide",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/anvil_working_guide.json",
          "text": "The steps required for a Pickaxe",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.15.text",
          "label": "Anvil Working Guide",
          "item_ref_count": 17,
          "count": 30
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/anvil_working_guide",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/anvil_working_guide.json",
          "text": "Step 2",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.16.title",
          "label": "Anvil Working Guide",
          "item_ref_count": 17,
          "count": 30
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/anvil_working_guide",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/anvil_working_guide.json",
          "text": "While our main goal for the Work Amount is to align it with the Target Work, we need to make sure both that requirement AND the Steps requirements are fulfilled, as such, directly aligning the Work Amount with the Target Work will not yield desirable results. Instead, we can calculate the a value derived from Target Work and \"requiredWork\"",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.16.text",
          "label": "Anvil Working Guide",
          "item_ref_count": 17,
          "count": 30
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/anvil_working_guide",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/anvil_working_guide.json",
          "text": "This value can be obtained depending on the Sign of \"requiredWork\" (IE: if the value is Negative or Positive). - If \"requiredWork\" is PositiveSubtract \"requiredWork\"'s Absolute Value from \"Target Work\"83 - 6 == 77 - If \"requiredWork\" is NegativeAdd \"requiredWork\"'s Absolute Value to \"Target Work\"83 + 6 = 89",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.17.text",
          "label": "Anvil Working Guide",
          "item_ref_count": 17,
          "count": 30
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/anvil_working_guide",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/anvil_working_guide.json",
          "text": "Since the \"requiredWork\" for our item is -6, the value we're looking for is 89. You may be wondering, how can you get exact numerical values for your Target Work? Well, the Anvil UI shows us with the Work Bar. It only shows the multiples of 20, but we can know the other numbers easily via the colored lines: - Light Gray: Represents a multiple of 5 - Gray: Represents an Odd Number - Dark Gray: Represents an Even Number",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.18.text",
          "label": "Anvil Working Guide",
          "item_ref_count": 17,
          "count": 30
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/anvil_working_guide",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/anvil_working_guide.json",
          "text": "Step 3",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.20.title",
          "label": "Anvil Working Guide",
          "item_ref_count": 17,
          "count": 30
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/anvil_working_guide",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/anvil_working_guide.json",
          "text": "With the value derived from \"Target Work\" and \"requiredWork\", we now need to reach said Work value, this can be done either manually by adding the numbers attached for each step, or by using the cheat sheet in the UI bar. Each color represents the Step Type in the UI. IE: Red == Shrink (+16)",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.20.text",
          "label": "Anvil Working Guide",
          "item_ref_count": 17,
          "count": 30
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/anvil_working_guide",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/anvil_working_guide.json",
          "text": "16 + 16 + 16 + 16 + 16 + 7 + 2 = 89",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.21.text",
          "label": "Anvil Working Guide",
          "item_ref_count": 17,
          "count": 30
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/anvil_working_guide",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/anvil_working_guide.json",
          "text": "Step 4",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.22.title",
          "label": "Anvil Working Guide",
          "item_ref_count": 17,
          "count": 30
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/anvil_working_guide",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/anvil_working_guide.json",
          "text": "Now that we know the required steps, its time to reach the Value derived from \"Target Work\" and \"requiredWork\". For a pickaxe head where it's TotalWork value is 83, we need to reach 89. As such, we do: (Shrink x 5) -> Bend -> Punch. Once our Work value is at our desired value, just follow the Required Steps, which for a pickaxe head its: Draw -> Bend -> Punch. And Voila! We've obtained a Perfectly Forged Item!",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.22.text",
          "label": "Anvil Working Guide",
          "item_ref_count": 17,
          "count": 30
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/anvil_working_guide",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/anvil_working_guide.json",
          "text": "An Ingot with No Work->Desired Work Value Reached->Doing the Required Steps for our Item.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.23.text",
          "label": "Anvil Working Guide",
          "item_ref_count": 17,
          "count": 30
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/anvil_working_guide",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/anvil_working_guide.json",
          "text": "Lets see this process with other items, such as a Plate, or a Rod. Again, the Target Work differs by the world seed, so their values will be different on your world. Plate Target Value: 111 Required Steps: Hit x 3, Any Order. \"requiredWork\": -3 x 3 = -9 Derived Value: 111 + 9 = 120. Reaching the Value: (Shrink x 5)->(Upset x 2)->(Punch x 2) Getting the Item: 120 - (Light Hit x 3) == 111. Both requirements met.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.24.text",
          "label": "Anvil Working Guide",
          "item_ref_count": 17,
          "count": 30
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/anvil_working_guide",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/anvil_working_guide.json",
          "text": "Rod Target Value: 78 Required Steps: Draw->Draw->Bend \"requiredWork\": (-15 x 2) + 7 = -23 Derived Value: 78 + 23 = 101. Reaching the Value: (Shrink x 5)->(Bend x 3) Getting the Item: 101 - 15 - 15 + 7 = 78.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.25.text",
          "label": "Anvil Working Guide",
          "item_ref_count": 17,
          "count": 30
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/anvil_working_guide",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/anvil_working_guide.json",
          "text": "Other Tidbits",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.26.title",
          "label": "Anvil Working Guide",
          "item_ref_count": 17,
          "count": 30
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/anvil_working_guide",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/anvil_working_guide.json",
          "text": "If one of the Required Steps is Empty, it means it's a Wild Card, any Step can be used. If you fail your calculations, you can always melt and cast your item back into an ingot, this will remove the \"worked\" tag for the item, letting you try again to perfectly forge it.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.26.text",
          "label": "Anvil Working Guide",
          "item_ref_count": 17,
          "count": 30
        },
        {

          "text": "Steel is an advanced material which can be used to create tools and Armor, and comes in a few different varieties: Steel, Black Steel, Red Steel, and Blue Steel. In order to create steel, you must first create Pig Iron in a Blast Furnace, and cast it into Ingots.",

          "text": "Weak Blue Steel Ingots can be welded with Black Steel Ingots to create High Carbon Blue Steel Ingots. Finally, these can be worked on an Anvil to create Blue Steel Ingots.",

          "text": "Blue Steel can be used to create tools and Armor, and a Blue Steel Bucket, which can be used to transport 1000 mB of both liquid fluids, and Lava.",

        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/surviving_mars/better_fuel",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/surviving_mars/better_fuel.json",
          "text": "Better Fuel",
          "key": "guide-page:name",
          "label": "Better Fuel",
          "item_ref_count": 5,
          "recipe_ref_count": 1,
          "count": 4
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/surviving_mars/better_fuel",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/surviving_mars/better_fuel.json",
          "text": "Cryo Freezer",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.0.title",
          "label": "Better Fuel",
          "item_ref_count": 5,
          "recipe_ref_count": 1,
          "count": 4
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/surviving_mars/better_fuel",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/surviving_mars/better_fuel.json",
          "text": "Fuel is hard to get; it requires venturing out to the ocean, looking for oil spouts. The Cryo Freezer introduces a new way to obtain a better fuel - Cryo Fuel. Cryo Fuel is much more efficient than refined fuel, allowing you to launch a rocket with just one bucket.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.0.text",
          "label": "Better Fuel",
          "item_ref_count": 5,
          "recipe_ref_count": 1,
          "count": 4
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/surviving_mars/better_fuel",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/surviving_mars/better_fuel.json",
          "text": "It's created by collecting ice shards, which are found as an ore underground on cold planets. The ice shard then needs to be inserted into a Cryo Freezer, and it will convert to 25 mB of Cryo Fuel. Alternatively, you can convert ice, packed ice and blue ice to fuel. Once you've made at least two buckets (one for a launch and the other for a return trip), place the buckets in the rocket fuel slot.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.1.text",
          "label": "Better Fuel",
          "item_ref_count": 5,
          "recipe_ref_count": 1,
          "count": 4
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/surviving_mars/better_fuel",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/surviving_mars/better_fuel.json",
          "text": "Cryo Fuel",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.3.title",
          "label": "Better Fuel",
          "item_ref_count": 5,
          "recipe_ref_count": 1,
          "count": 4
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/surviving_mars/better_fuel",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/surviving_mars/better_fuel.json",
          "text": "In addition to being an excellent fuel, cryo fuel has some other features. When placed, it will damage anything inside, similar to lava. It also freezes water, allowing for an infinite ice source.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.3.text",
          "label": "Better Fuel",
          "item_ref_count": 5,
          "recipe_ref_count": 1,
          "count": 4
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/surviving_mars/detection",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/surviving_mars/detection.json",
          "text": "Oxygen Sensor",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.0.title",
          "label": "Detection",
          "item_ref_count": 3,
          "recipe_ref_count": 1,
          "count": 2
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/surviving_mars/detection",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/surviving_mars/detection.json",
          "text": "The oxygen sensor is a block that will emit a redstone signal when it detects oxygen. You can shift-right-click it to invert the signal. Despite its name, you can also change its detection type by right-clicking with a wrench. It has the option to detect oxygen, safe temperature, and normal gravity.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.0.text",
          "label": "Detection",
          "item_ref_count": 3,
          "recipe_ref_count": 1,
          "count": 2
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/surviving_mars/energizer",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/surviving_mars/energizer.json",
          "text": "The energizer is a machine capable of powering items and storing large amounts of energy. To charge an item, power the energizer and then right-click on the energizer with that item. It stores 2 million energy, making it capable of charging machines for a very long time. It also retains its energy when broken.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.0.text",
          "label": "Energizer",
          "item_ref_count": 3,
          "recipe_ref_count": 1,
          "count": 2
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/surviving_mars/flags",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/surviving_mars/flags.json",
          "text": "Flags are decorative blocks available in 16 colors. By default, when placed, they will display the face of the flag owner. They can be configured to display a custom image from a URL by right-clicking and entering the URL in the GUI. This will display the internet image onto the flag.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.0.text",
          "label": "Flags",
          "item_ref_count": 5,
          "recipe_ref_count": 1,
          "count": 2
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/surviving_mars/fluid_pipes",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/surviving_mars/fluid_pipes.json",
          "text": "Fluid Pipes",
          "key": "guide-page:name",
          "label": "Fluid Pipes",
          "item_ref_count": 4,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 4
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/surviving_mars/fluid_pipes",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/surviving_mars/fluid_pipes.json",
          "text": "Fluid Pipes",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.0.title",
          "label": "Fluid Pipes",
          "item_ref_count": 4,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 4
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/surviving_mars/fluid_pipes",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/surviving_mars/fluid_pipes.json",
          "text": "Fluid pipes are similar to cables but with fluid transfer instead of energy transfer. To use them, craft some fluid pipes and a wrench. Then, right-click on one of the pipes with the wrench to cycle through the pipe's modes: 'none,' 'normal,' 'insert,' and 'extract.'",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.0.text",
          "label": "Fluid Pipes",
          "item_ref_count": 4,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 4
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/surviving_mars/fluid_pipes",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/surviving_mars/fluid_pipes.json",
          "text": "Pipes with 'insert' set will receive fluid from the network, while pipes with 'extract' set will pump fluid into the network.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.1.text",
          "label": "Fluid Pipes",
          "item_ref_count": 4,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 4
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/surviving_mars/fluid_pipes",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/surviving_mars/fluid_pipes.json",
          "text": "Like cables, fluid pipes also have a duct block for transfering fluids safely in and out of sealed structures.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.3.text",
          "label": "Fluid Pipes",
          "item_ref_count": 4,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 4
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/surviving_mars/industrial_lamps",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/surviving_mars/industrial_lamps.json",

        },
        {

          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/surviving_mars/industrial_lamps",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/surviving_mars/industrial_lamps.json",
          "text": "Industrial Lamps",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.0.title",
          "label": "Industrial Lamps",
          "item_ref_count": 6,
          "recipe_ref_count": 1,

        },
        {

          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/surviving_mars/industrial_lamps.json",
          "text": "Industrial lamps are available in all 16 colors, and in small and large sizes. By default, these will all emit normal white light; however, if you have Shimmer, each light will emit its respective color.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.0.text",
          "label": "Industrial Lamps",
          "item_ref_count": 6,
          "recipe_ref_count": 1,
          "count": 2
        },

          "text": "The netherite space suit is an upgraded version of the standard space suit, featuring permanent fire resistance, more protection and the ability to survive on Venus and Mercury.           "text": "Sliding doors are large 3x3 doors. They seal oxygen when closed, making them great candidates for airlocks. They can be locked by shift-right-clicking them with a wrench. Locked doors can only be opened with redstone.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.0.text",
          "label": "Sliding Doors",

          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 4
        },
        {

          "text": "Globes are trophy blocks found as a reward at the end of a dungeon. Globes offer no practical function and are instead a decoration block. They can be spun around by right-clicking or can spin forever when powered by redstone. Only the Moon globe is obtainable in survival at the moment.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.0.text",
          "label": "Trophies",
          "item_ref_count": 5,
          "count": 2
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",

        {
          "kind": "guide_page",

          "source": "jar:TerraFirmaCraft-Forge-1.20.1-3.2.21.jar!assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/mechanics/steel.json",
          "text": "Steel is an advanced material which can be used to create tools and Armor, and comes in a few different varieties: Steel, Black Steel, Red Steel, and Blue Steel. In order to create steel, you must first create Pig Iron in a Blast Furnace, and cast it into Ingots.",

          "label": "Steel",
          "item_ref_count": 9,
          "recipe_ref_count": 4,
          "count": 14
        },

          "text": "A Pig Iron Ingot can then be worked in an anvil to create a High Carbon Steel ingot, which can be worked again to create a Steel Ingot",

          "item_ref_count": 9,
          "recipe_ref_count": 4,
          "count": 14

          "source": "jar:TerraFirmaCraft-Forge-1.20.1-3.2.21.jar!assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/mechanics/steel.json",
          "text": "Red Steel can be used to create tools and Armor, and a Red Steel Bucket, which can be used to transport 1000 mB of both liquid fluids, and Lava",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.13.text",
          "label": "Steel",
          "item_ref_count": 9,
          "recipe_ref_count": 4,
          "count": 14
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/surviving_mars/better_fuel",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/surviving_mars/better_fuel.json",
          "text": "Better Fuel",
          "key": "guide-page:name",
          "label": "Better Fuel",
          "item_ref_count": 5,
          "recipe_ref_count": 1,
          "count": 4
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/surviving_mars/better_fuel",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/surviving_mars/better_fuel.json",
          "text": "Cryo Freezer",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.0.title",
          "label": "Better Fuel",
          "item_ref_count": 5,
          "recipe_ref_count": 1,
          "count": 4
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/surviving_mars/better_fuel",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/surviving_mars/better_fuel.json",
          "text": "Fuel is hard to get; it requires venturing out to the ocean, looking for oil spouts. The Cryo Freezer introduces a new way to obtain a better fuel - Cryo Fuel. Cryo Fuel is much more efficient than refined fuel, allowing you to launch a rocket with just one bucket.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.0.text",
          "label": "Better Fuel",
          "item_ref_count": 5,
          "recipe_ref_count": 1,
          "count": 4
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/surviving_mars/better_fuel",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/surviving_mars/better_fuel.json",
          "text": "It's created by collecting ice shards, which are found as an ore underground on cold planets. The ice shard then needs to be inserted into a Cryo Freezer, and it will convert to 25 mB of Cryo Fuel. Alternatively, you can convert ice, packed ice and blue ice to fuel. Once you've made at least two buckets (one for a launch and the other for a return trip), place the buckets in the rocket fuel slot.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.1.text",
          "label": "Better Fuel",
          "item_ref_count": 5,
          "recipe_ref_count": 1,
          "count": 4
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/surviving_mars/better_fuel",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/surviving_mars/better_fuel.json",
          "text": "Cryo Fuel",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.3.title",
          "label": "Better Fuel",
          "item_ref_count": 5,
          "recipe_ref_count": 1,
          "count": 4
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/surviving_mars/better_fuel",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/surviving_mars/better_fuel.json",
          "text": "In addition to being an excellent fuel, cryo fuel has some other features. When placed, it will damage anything inside, similar to lava. It also freezes water, allowing for an infinite ice source.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.3.text",
          "label": "Better Fuel",
          "item_ref_count": 5,
          "recipe_ref_count": 1,
          "count": 4
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/surviving_mars/detection",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/surviving_mars/detection.json",
          "text": "Oxygen Sensor",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.0.title",
          "label": "Detection",
          "item_ref_count": 3,
          "recipe_ref_count": 1,
          "count": 2
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/surviving_mars/detection",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/surviving_mars/detection.json",
          "text": "The oxygen sensor is a block that will emit a redstone signal when it detects oxygen. You can shift-right-click it to invert the signal. Despite its name, you can also change its detection type by right-clicking with a wrench. It has the option to detect oxygen, safe temperature, and normal gravity.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.0.text",
          "label": "Detection",
          "item_ref_count": 3,
          "recipe_ref_count": 1,
          "count": 2
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/surviving_mars/energizer",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/surviving_mars/energizer.json",
          "text": "The energizer is a machine capable of powering items and storing large amounts of energy. To charge an item, power the energizer and then right-click on the energizer with that item. It stores 2 million energy, making it capable of charging machines for a very long time. It also retains its energy when broken.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.0.text",
          "label": "Energizer",
          "item_ref_count": 3,
          "recipe_ref_count": 1,
          "count": 2
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/surviving_mars/flags",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/surviving_mars/flags.json",
          "text": "Flags are decorative blocks available in 16 colors. By default, when placed, they will display the face of the flag owner. They can be configured to display a custom image from a URL by right-clicking and entering the URL in the GUI. This will display the internet image onto the flag.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.0.text",
          "label": "Flags",
          "item_ref_count": 5,
          "recipe_ref_count": 1,
          "count": 2
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/surviving_mars/fluid_pipes",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/surviving_mars/fluid_pipes.json",
          "text": "Fluid Pipes",
          "key": "guide-page:name",
          "label": "Fluid Pipes",
          "item_ref_count": 4,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 4
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/surviving_mars/fluid_pipes",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/surviving_mars/fluid_pipes.json",
          "text": "Fluid Pipes",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.0.title",
          "label": "Fluid Pipes",
          "item_ref_count": 4,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 4
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/surviving_mars/fluid_pipes",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/surviving_mars/fluid_pipes.json",
          "text": "Fluid pipes are similar to cables but with fluid transfer instead of energy transfer. To use them, craft some fluid pipes and a wrench. Then, right-click on one of the pipes with the wrench to cycle through the pipe's modes: 'none,' 'normal,' 'insert,' and 'extract.'",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.0.text",
          "label": "Fluid Pipes",
          "item_ref_count": 4,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 4
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/surviving_mars/fluid_pipes",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/surviving_mars/fluid_pipes.json",
          "text": "Pipes with 'insert' set will receive fluid from the network, while pipes with 'extract' set will pump fluid into the network.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.1.text",
          "label": "Fluid Pipes",
          "item_ref_count": 4,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 4
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/surviving_mars/fluid_pipes",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/surviving_mars/fluid_pipes.json",
          "text": "Like cables, fluid pipes also have a duct block for transfering fluids safely in and out of sealed structures.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.3.text",
          "label": "Fluid Pipes",
          "item_ref_count": 4,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 4
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/surviving_mars/industrial_lamps",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/surviving_mars/industrial_lamps.json",

          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/surviving_mars/industrial_lamps.json",
          "text": "Industrial Lamps",

        {

          "text": "Industrial lamps are available in all 16 colors, and in small and large sizes. By default, these will all emit normal white light; however, if you have Shimmer, each light will emit its respective color.",

          "text": "The netherite space suit is an upgraded version of the standard space suit, featuring permanent fire resistance, more protection and the ability to survive on Venus and Mercury.         },

          "text": "Sliding Doors",

          "text": "Sliding doors are large 3x3 doors. They seal oxygen when closed, making them great candidates for airlocks. They can be locked by shift-right-clicking them with a wrench. Locked doors can only be opened with redstone.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.0.text",
          "label": "Sliding Doors",
          "item_ref_count": 6,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 4
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",

          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/surviving_mars/trophies.json",
          "text": "Globes are trophy blocks found as a reward at the end of a dungeon. Globes offer no practical function and are instead a decoration block. They can be spun around by right-clicking or can spin forever when powered by redstone. Only the Moon globe is obtainable in survival at the moment.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.0.text",
          "label": "Trophies",
          "item_ref_count": 5,
          "count": 2
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",

          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/surviving_mars/trophies.json",
          "text": "Space Paintings",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.1.title",
          "label": "Trophies",

        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
