          "text": "Space paintings are found in chests throughout dungeons. They work exactly like regular paintings but only place paintings from this mod. There are 14 pieces to look for.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.1.text",
          "label": "Trophies",
          "item_ref_count": 5,
          "count": 2
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/surviving_mars/venus_and_mercury",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/surviving_mars/venus_and_mercury.json",
          "text": "Venus and Mercury",
          "key": "guide-page:name",
          "label": "Venus and Mercury",
          "item_ref_count": 5,
          "count": 2
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/surviving_mars/venus_and_mercury",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/surviving_mars/venus_and_mercury.json",
          "text": "Once you have enough Ostrum to craft a complete netherite space suit set and all of the components of the tier three rocket, you can travel to Venus and Mercury. Please note that if you enter these planets without a netherite space suit or fire resistance, you will die very fast. The next material that you seek is Calorite.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.0.text",
          "label": "Venus and Mercury",
          "item_ref_count": 5,
          "count": 2
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/surviving_mars/venus_and_mercury",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/surviving_mars/venus_and_mercury.json",
          "text": "Calorite is used to craft the ultimate rocket capable of travelling to a new solar system.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.1.text",
          "label": "Venus and Mercury",
          "item_ref_count": 5,
          "count": 2
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/creating_plates",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/creating_plates.json",
          "text": "Creating Plates",
          "key": "guide-page:name",
          "label": "Creating Plates",
          "item_ref_count": 3,
          "recipe_ref_count": 1,
          "count": 2
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/creating_plates",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/creating_plates.json",
          "text": "Once you've got energy, you'll want to craft a compressor. This machine can compress ingots and blocks into plates, which are needed to craft many things.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.0.text",
          "label": "Creating Plates",
          "item_ref_count": 3,
          "recipe_ref_count": 1,
          "count": 2
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/fuel",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/fuel.json",
          "text": "Even after you place your rocket, you will not be able to fly just yet. To fly, you will need to fill the rocket with fuel.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.0.text",
          "label": "Fuel",
          "item_ref_count": 6,
          "recipe_ref_count": 1,
          "count": 4
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/fuel",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/fuel.json",
          "text": "Obtaining Fuel",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.1.title",
          "label": "Fuel",
          "item_ref_count": 6,
          "recipe_ref_count": 1,
          "count": 4
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/fuel",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/fuel.json",
          "text": "Oil is found in large amounts spouting over the ocean surface. Collect as much oil as you can, as oil is non-renewable, and you need a lot of it for each rocket launch.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.1.text",
          "label": "Fuel",
          "item_ref_count": 6,
          "recipe_ref_count": 1,
          "count": 4
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/fuel",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/fuel.json",
          "text": "Obtaining Fuel",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.2.title",
          "label": "Fuel",
          "item_ref_count": 6,
          "recipe_ref_count": 1,
          "count": 4
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/fuel",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/fuel.json",
          "text": "After collecting enough oil (at least six buckets for a launch and return), you will need to refine the oil into fuel. To do this, you will need to craft a fuel refinery. Power it, then place the oil in the left slot, and it will be refined into fuel.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.2.text",
          "label": "Fuel",
          "item_ref_count": 6,
          "recipe_ref_count": 1,
          "count": 4
        },
        {

        {
          "kind": "guide_page",

        {
          "kind": "guide_page",

          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "Hazardous Materials",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.0.title",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "Some ores, dusts and chemicals are hazardous and can cause negative effects or even kill you if they are carried in your inventory. When carried, they are displayed on screen with a Status Effect. Certain equipment such as masks, gloves, and the hazardous material suit can be used to counter these effects.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.0.text",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "All of the effects",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.1.title",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "- Arsenicosis - Asbestosis - Berylliosis - Carbon Monoxide poisoning - Carcinogens - Chemical burns - Irritants - Methanol poisoning - Nauseating chemicals - Poisonous materials - Radioactive materials - Silicosis The next page will provide information on how to deal with these effects.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.1.text",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "Prevention and Cures",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.2.title",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "- Rocks? - Containers - The Face Mask - The Rubber Gloves - The Hazmat Suit - Pills, Tablets and Salvos - The RadAwayᵗᵐ pill - The Unthinkable...",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.2.text",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "Rocks!",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.3.title",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "The easiest way to prevent hazardous effects is to not pick up the dangerous items at all. Filling your inventory with Rocks, for example, will let you pick and choose which items you want to pick up, letting you deal with the hazardous ones later.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.3.text",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "Hazardous materials only deal damage while they are in your inventory, but that doesn't apply to other containers! Hazardous materials will not deal damage while they are in another container such as a Backpack or Vessel. Right-clicking while holding a vessel will allow direct transfer of its contents to and from containers.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.4.text",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "Face Mask",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.5.title",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "The Face Mask provides protection from any Inhalation hazards, such as Arsenicosis.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.5.text",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "Rubber gloves",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.6.title",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "The Rubber gloves can either be made from Leather and Latex, or out of Rubber Sheets. They provide protection from any Skin Contact hazards, such as Beryllium Dust.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.6.text",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "First, knap the leather into mittens.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.7.text",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "Mittens are then soaked in Vinegar, a mixture of fruit and alcohol.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.8.text",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "Prepared leather gloves are then heated in a vat with Vulcanized Latex, one step away from rubber.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.9.text",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "Finally, the latex-soaked gloves are heated in an Oven.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.10.text",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "The Hazmat Suit",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.11.title",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "A completed Hazmat suit provides immunity from every hazard, even radiation. It is made in an LV Assembler from Polyethylene and Polyvinyl Chloride. Fun fact! You can also look up #ppe_armor in JEI for more equipment that provides protection from hazardous materials.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.11.text",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "In case you do get heavily exposed to a hazard, there are some Medicines that can help you recover. Basic Pills are the most primitive and easy to make, but most come with Negative Side Effects. Tablets and Salvos are more effective and have less side effects, but they require LV equipment and more advanced resources to make.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.12.text",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "The RadAwayᵗᵐ pill",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.13.title",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "This is The Ultimate cure for ALL the hazards and the ONLY effective cure to Radiation. However, it is also the most Expensive and Difficult to make, requiring HV tier equipment and advanced materials.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.13.text",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "If all else fails, bringing along a bed to respawn is a good idea. If you don't have access to Wool or String, you can also make a Thatch Bed.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.14.text",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "Arsenicosis is an illness caused by inhaling Arsenic from its dust, vapor or Realgar. It slowly increases hunger, followed by nausea, and eventually death. The Face Mask and the Hazmat Suit provide protection from Arsenicosis.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.15.text",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "Asbestosis is an illness caused by inhaling Asbestos dust. If carried for long enough, it causes hunger. The Face Mask and the Hazmat Suit provide protection from Asbestosis.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.16.text",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "Berylliosis is an illness caused by skin contact with Beryllium dust or Liquid Beryllium. At first it might seem that it doesn't do much. However, the longer the exposure, the faster it kills you. Gloves and the Hazmat Suit provide protection from Berylliosis.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.17.text",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "Carbon Monoxide poisoning",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.18.title",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "Carbon Monoxide poisoning is an illness caused by inhaling Carbon Monoxide gas. Prolonged exposure causes nausea and quick death. The Face Mask and the Hazmat Suit provide protection from Carbon Monoxide.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.18.text",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "Carcinogens are substances that cause Cancer. They include Chromium Dust aswell as some organic compounds, such as Benzene and its products. Carcinogens don't go away on their own, but they give plenty of warnings before doing any real harm. It starts off with Weakness, followed by Hunger, then Slowness and later on Mining Fatique. Only when substantial enough exposure is accumulated it causes Death.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.19.text",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "The Face Mask protects from inhalation of harmful chemicals, while the Gloves protect from contact with Chromium Dust. The Hazmat Suit protects from both. In case of severe exposure, it is advised to take some Medicines to Prevent any possible damage.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.20.text",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "Chemical burns",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.21.title",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "Chemical burns are caused by inhalation or skin contact with certain Gases, Acids, Bases or Dusts. Exposure causes Weakness. The Face Mask protects from inhalation, while the Gloves protects from direct skin contact. The Hazmat Suit protects from everything.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.21.text",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "Irritation is caused by inhalation of Ammonium Formate or skin contact with Chromite Dust. Short contact only causes Weakness, but if ignored for longer it starts Damaging Randomly. The Face Mask protects from inhalation, while the Gloves protects from direct skin contact. The Hazmat Suit protects from both.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.22.text",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "Methanol poisoning",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.23.title",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "Methanol poisoning is caused by inhalation of Methanol. It causes a strong Blindness effect. The Face Mask and the Hazmat Suit protects from inhalation.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.23.text",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "Nauseating chemicals",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.24.title",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "Nauseating chemicals, such as Butyraldehyde, are substances that cause Nausea when inhaled. The Face Mask and the Hazmat Suit protect from inhalation.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.24.text",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "Poisonous materials",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.25.title",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",

          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "Finally, the latex-soaked gloves are heated in an Oven.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.10.text",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "The Hazmat Suit",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.11.title",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "A completed Hazmat suit provides immunity from every hazard, even radiation. It is made in an LV Assembler from Polyethylene and Polyvinyl Chloride. Fun fact! You can also look up #ppe_armor in JEI for more equipment that provides protection from hazardous materials.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.11.text",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "In case you do get heavily exposed to a hazard, there are some Medicines that can help you recover. Basic Pills are the most primitive and easy to make, but most come with Negative Side Effects. Tablets and Salvos are more effective and have less side effects, but they require LV equipment and more advanced resources to make.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.12.text",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "The RadAwayᵗᵐ pill",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.13.title",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "This is The Ultimate cure for ALL the hazards and the ONLY effective cure to Radiation. However, it is also the most Expensive and Difficult to make, requiring HV tier equipment and advanced materials.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.13.text",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "If all else fails, bringing along a bed to respawn is a good idea. If you don't have access to Wool or String, you can also make a Thatch Bed.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.14.text",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "Arsenicosis is an illness caused by inhaling Arsenic from its dust, vapor or Realgar. It slowly increases hunger, followed by nausea, and eventually death. The Face Mask and the Hazmat Suit provide protection from Arsenicosis.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.15.text",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "Asbestosis is an illness caused by inhaling Asbestos dust. If carried for long enough, it causes hunger. The Face Mask and the Hazmat Suit provide protection from Asbestosis.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.16.text",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "Berylliosis is an illness caused by skin contact with Beryllium dust or Liquid Beryllium. At first it might seem that it doesn't do much. However, the longer the exposure, the faster it kills you. Gloves and the Hazmat Suit provide protection from Berylliosis.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.17.text",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "Carbon Monoxide poisoning",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.18.title",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "Carbon Monoxide poisoning is an illness caused by inhaling Carbon Monoxide gas. Prolonged exposure causes nausea and quick death. The Face Mask and the Hazmat Suit provide protection from Carbon Monoxide.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.18.text",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "Carcinogens are substances that cause Cancer. They include Chromium Dust aswell as some organic compounds, such as Benzene and its products. Carcinogens don't go away on their own, but they give plenty of warnings before doing any real harm. It starts off with Weakness, followed by Hunger, then Slowness and later on Mining Fatique. Only when substantial enough exposure is accumulated it causes Death.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.19.text",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "The Face Mask protects from inhalation of harmful chemicals, while the Gloves protect from contact with Chromium Dust. The Hazmat Suit protects from both. In case of severe exposure, it is advised to take some Medicines to Prevent any possible damage.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.20.text",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "Chemical burns",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.21.title",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "Chemical burns are caused by inhalation or skin contact with certain Gases, Acids, Bases or Dusts. Exposure causes Weakness. The Face Mask protects from inhalation, while the Gloves protects from direct skin contact. The Hazmat Suit protects from everything.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.21.text",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "Irritation is caused by inhalation of Ammonium Formate or skin contact with Chromite Dust. Short contact only causes Weakness, but if ignored for longer it starts Damaging Randomly. The Face Mask protects from inhalation, while the Gloves protects from direct skin contact. The Hazmat Suit protects from both.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.22.text",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "Methanol poisoning",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.23.title",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "Methanol poisoning is caused by inhalation of Methanol. It causes a strong Blindness effect. The Face Mask and the Hazmat Suit protects from inhalation.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.23.text",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "Nauseating chemicals",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.24.title",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "Nauseating chemicals, such as Butyraldehyde, are substances that cause Nausea when inhaled. The Face Mask and the Hazmat Suit protect from inhalation.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.24.text",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "Poisonous materials",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.25.title",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "There are two types of Poisonous materials. Weak include Lead Dust, while the stronger poisons include Nitrogen Dioxide. Weak poisons cause a Progressively Worsening Poison effect, while Regular poisons cause Weakness and a Stronger Poison effect. The Face Mask protects from inhalation, while the Gloves protects from direct skin contact. The Hazmat Suit protects from any contact.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.25.text",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "Radioactive materials",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.26.title",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "Most Radioactive substances like Uranium 238 you will only meet at EV tier or above. They will Permanently Irradiate you. Small exposure causes glowing, but prolonged contact triggers a quick Death. We know it looks tasty and has a billion calories, but PLEASE DO NOT EAT URANIUM!",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.26.text",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "Radioactive materials",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.27.title",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "Only the Hazmat Suit, as well as some advanced armors provide full protection from radiation. In the case you do get irradiated, only the RadAwayᵗᵐ pill can cure you.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.27.text",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "Silicosis is an illness caused by inhaling Silicon Dioxide Dust. Exposure causes a Reduction in both Health and the Air Supply you have while diving Under Water. The Face Mask and the Hazmat Suit provide protection from inhalation of silicon dioxide.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.28.text",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questsstoneage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questsstoneage.snbt",
          "text": "As you begin your journey, the first thing you'll notice is a completely changed world. You can no longer break trees with your fists, but fret not, for any caveman is not a real caveman without his stone tools!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "As you begin your journey, the first thing you'll notice is a completely changed world. You can no longer break trees with your fists, but fret not, for any caveman is not a real caveman without his stone tools!",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questsstoneage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questsstoneage.snbt",
          "text": "Instead of crafting a wooden pickaxe, you can just pick up rocks from the ground. Begin by collecting at least 4 rocks. You can collect rocks by breaking or right-clicking them with an empty hand.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "As you begin your journey, the first thing you'll notice is a completely changed world. You can no longer break trees with your fists, but fret not, for any caveman is not a real caveman without his stone tools!",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {

        },
        {

        {

          "label": "As you begin your journey, the first thing you'll notice is a completely changed world. You can no longer break trees with your fists, but fret not, for any caveman is not a real caveman without his stone tools!",

        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",

          "label": "As you begin your journey, the first thing you'll notice is a completely changed world. You can no longer break trees with your fists, but fret not, for any caveman is not a real caveman without his stone tools!",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questsstoneage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questsstoneage.snbt",
          "text": "Any loose rock or flint",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "As you begin your journey, the first thing you'll notice is a completely changed world. You can no longer break trees with your fists, but fret not, for any caveman is not a real caveman without his stone tools!",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questsstoneage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questsstoneage.snbt",
          "text": "Find some Rocks",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "As you begin your journey, the first thing you'll notice is a completely changed world. You can no longer break trees with your fists, but fret not, for any caveman is not a real caveman without his stone tools!",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questsstoneage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questsstoneage.snbt",
          "text": "Thirst is represented by the blue bar above your hunger. You can and will die of dehydration if you dont keep your thirst meter filled! The easiest way to have a drink is by drinking from natural ponds in the wild, by right-clicking on them with an empty hand.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "As you begin your journey, the first thing you'll notice is a completely changed world. You can no longer break trees with your fists, but fret not, for any caveman is not a real caveman without his stone tools!",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questsstoneage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questsstoneage.snbt",
          "text": "To complete this quest, you need to drink a Potable source of water, can be regular or river water. You may need to drink multiple times so the quest completes properly",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "As you begin your journey, the first thing you'll notice is a completely changed world. You can no longer break trees with your fists, but fret not, for any caveman is not a real caveman without his stone tools!",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questsstoneage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questsstoneage.snbt",
          "text": "You don't have to worry about purifying water here, though Salt Water will just make you more thirsty.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "As you begin your journey, the first thing you'll notice is a completely changed world. You can no longer break trees with your fists, but fret not, for any caveman is not a real caveman without his stone tools!",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questsstoneage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questsstoneage.snbt",
          "text": "Remember to drink water!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "As you begin your journey, the first thing you'll notice is a completely changed world. You can no longer break trees with your fists, but fret not, for any caveman is not a real caveman without his stone tools!",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questsstoneage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questsstoneage.snbt",
          "text": "Drink from a Water Source with your Hand. (Not Salty or Hot)",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "As you begin your journey, the first thing you'll notice is a completely changed world. You can no longer break trees with your fists, but fret not, for any caveman is not a real caveman without his stone tools!",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",

          "text": "Fuel is hard to get; it requires venturing out to the ocean, looking for oil spouts. The Cryo Freezer introduces a new way to obtain a better fuel - Cryo Fuel. Cryo Fuel is much more efficient than refined fuel, allowing you to launch a rocket with just one bucket.",

          "item_ref_count": 5,
          "recipe_ref_count": 1,

          "text": "It's created by collecting ice shards, which are found as an ore underground on cold planets.           "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/firmaciv/sloop.json",
          "text": "Iron Age already? Well, I guess it's high time you built yourself a proper ship. The sloop is 4 blocks wide and over 8 blocks long, an impressive upgrade from the rowboat!           "label": "Sloops",
          "item_ref_count": 10,
          "recipe_ref_count": 2,

        },

          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/firmaciv/sloop.json",
          "text": "The sloop is expensive, however, requiring a wealth of wrought iron, copper, wool, and other materials. But materials aren't the only cost!           "key": "guide-page:pages.2.text",
          "label": "Sloops",
          "item_ref_count": 10,
          "recipe_ref_count": 2,
          "count": 13
        },

          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/firmaciv/sloop.json",
          "text": "Here is bill of materials for constructing the sloop: 12 Wrought Iron Ingots 24 Copper Ingots 648 Lumber 34 Logs 24 Wool Cloth 6 String 72 Jute Fiber",

          "label": "Sloops",
          "item_ref_count": 10,
          "recipe_ref_count": 2,
          "count": 13
        },
        {

          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/firmaciv/sloop.json",
          "text": "Much like a rowboat, you'll start with Shipwright's Scaffolding. However, you'll also need a new flat variant for larger ships.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.4.text",
          "label": "Sloops",
          "item_ref_count": 10,

          "key": "guide-page:pages.12.text",
          "label": "Sloops",
          "item_ref_count": 10,
          "recipe_ref_count": 2,
          "count": 13
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/firmaciv/sloop",
          "source": "jar:FirmaCivilization-1.20.1-1.0.9.jar!assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/firmaciv/sloop.json",
          "text": "Steel Age already? Well, I guess it's high time you built yourself a proper ship. The sloop is 4 blocks wide and over 8 blocks long, an impressive upgrade from the rowboat! It holds up to 13 containers and up to 7 passengers, and, depending on the wind, can sail extremely fast. It can also carry up to 6 cannons!",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.0.text",
          "label": "Sloops",
          "item_ref_count": 10,
          "recipe_ref_count": 2,
          "count": 13
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/firmaciv/sloop",
          "source": "jar:FirmaCivilization-1.20.1-1.0.9.jar!assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/firmaciv/sloop.json",
          "text": "The sloop is expensive, however, requiring a wealth of steel, copper, wool, and other materials. But materials aren't the only cost! You'll have to learn how to sail, as well, and it can take some practice! You'll also likely want to build docks and other infrastructure if you plan on bringing your ship in close to shore.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.2.text",
          "label": "Sloops",
          "item_ref_count": 10,
          "recipe_ref_count": 2,
          "count": 13
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/firmaciv/sloop",
          "source": "jar:FirmaCivilization-1.20.1-1.0.9.jar!assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/firmaciv/sloop.json",
          "text": "Here is bill of materials for constructing the sloop: 12 Steel Ingots 24 Copper Ingots 648 Lumber 34 Logs 24 Wool Cloth 6 String 72 Jute Fiber",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.3.text",
          "label": "Sloops",
          "item_ref_count": 10,
          "recipe_ref_count": 2,
          "count": 13
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/firmaciv/sloop",
          "source": "jar:FirmaCivilization-1.20.1-1.0.9.jar!assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/firmaciv/sloop.json",
          "text": "Much like a rowboat, you'll start with Shipwright's Scaffolding. However, you'll also need a new flat variant for larger ships.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.4.text",
          "label": "Sloops",
          "item_ref_count": 10,
          "recipe_ref_count": 2,
          "count": 13
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/firmaciv/sloop",
          "source": "jar:FirmaCivilization-1.20.1-1.0.9.jar!assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/firmaciv/sloop.json",
          "text": "Sloop Scaffolding",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.5.name",
          "label": "Sloops",
          "item_ref_count": 10,
          "recipe_ref_count": 2,
          "count": 13
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/firmaciv/sloop",
          "source": "jar:FirmaCivilization-1.20.1-1.0.9.jar!assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/firmaciv/sloop.json",
          "text": "Shipwright's Scaffolding arranged in order to construct a sloop hull.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.5.text",
          "label": "Sloops",
          "item_ref_count": 10,
          "recipe_ref_count": 2,
          "count": 13
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/firmaciv/sloop",
          "source": "jar:FirmaCivilization-1.20.1-1.0.9.jar!assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/firmaciv/sloop.json",
          "text": "Next, you'll need to add planks of suitably a strong hardwood: Acacia Ash Aspen Birch Blackwood Chestnut Hickory Maple Oak Rosewood Sycamore",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.6.text",
          "label": "Sloops",
          "item_ref_count": 10,
          "recipe_ref_count": 2,
          "count": 13
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/firmaciv/sloop",
          "source": "jar:FirmaCivilization-1.20.1-1.0.9.jar!assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/firmaciv/sloop.json",
          "text": "Sloop Scaffolding",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.7.name",
          "label": "Sloops",
          "item_ref_count": 10,
          "recipe_ref_count": 2,
          "count": 13
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/firmaciv/sloop",
          "source": "jar:FirmaCivilization-1.20.1-1.0.9.jar!assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/firmaciv/sloop.json",
          "text": "Four planks have been added to each scaffold.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.7.text",
          "label": "Sloops",
          "item_ref_count": 10,
          "recipe_ref_count": 2,
          "count": 13
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/firmaciv/sloop",
          "source": "jar:FirmaCivilization-1.20.1-1.0.9.jar!assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/firmaciv/sloop.json",
          "text": "Sloop Scaffolding",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.8.name",
          "label": "Sloops",
          "item_ref_count": 10,
          "recipe_ref_count": 2,
          "count": 13
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/firmaciv/sloop",
          "source": "jar:FirmaCivilization-1.20.1-1.0.9.jar!assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/firmaciv/sloop.json",
          "text": "Using a hammer in your offhand, add four copper bolts to each scaffold. Copper bolts are smithed from copper ingots.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.8.text",
          "label": "Sloops",
          "item_ref_count": 10,
          "recipe_ref_count": 2,
          "count": 13
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/firmaciv/sloop",
          "source": "jar:FirmaCivilization-1.20.1-1.0.9.jar!assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/firmaciv/sloop.json",
          "text": "Sloop Scaffolding",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.9.name",
          "label": "Sloops",
          "item_ref_count": 10,
          "recipe_ref_count": 2,
          "count": 13
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/firmaciv/sloop",
          "source": "jar:FirmaCivilization-1.20.1-1.0.9.jar!assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/firmaciv/sloop.json",
          "text": "Finally, add the cleats to the hull. These are smithed from steel double ingots.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.9.text",
          "label": "Sloops",
          "item_ref_count": 10,
          "recipe_ref_count": 2,
          "count": 13
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/firmaciv/sloop",
          "source": "jar:FirmaCivilization-1.20.1-1.0.9.jar!assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/firmaciv/sloop.json",
          "text": "Building the hull is only the first step of sloop construction, however! After the hull is complete, look for the blue hammer icon and use to add the items that show next to your crosshair, building out the rest of the ship. The following pages contain recipes for unique items you'll need to complete the construction.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.10.text",
          "label": "Sloops",
          "item_ref_count": 10,
          "recipe_ref_count": 2,
          "count": 13
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/firmaciv/sloop",
          "source": "jar:FirmaCivilization-1.20.1-1.0.9.jar!assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/firmaciv/sloop.json",
          "text": "You'll also need to add an anchor, which is smithed from a Steel Double Sheet.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.12.text",
          "label": "Sloops",
          "item_ref_count": 10,
          "recipe_ref_count": 2,
          "count": 13
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/surviving_mars/better_fuel",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/surviving_mars/better_fuel.json",
          "text": "Better Fuel",
          "key": "guide-page:name",
          "label": "Better Fuel",
          "item_ref_count": 5,
          "recipe_ref_count": 1,
          "count": 4
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/surviving_mars/better_fuel",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/surviving_mars/better_fuel.json",
          "text": "Cryo Freezer",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.0.title",
          "label": "Better Fuel",
          "item_ref_count": 5,
          "recipe_ref_count": 1,
          "count": 4
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/surviving_mars/better_fuel",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/surviving_mars/better_fuel.json",
          "text": "Fuel is hard to get; it requires venturing out to the ocean, looking for oil spouts. The Cryo Freezer introduces a new way to obtain a better fuel - Cryo Fuel. Cryo Fuel is much more efficient than refined fuel, allowing you to launch a rocket with just one bucket.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.0.text",
          "label": "Better Fuel",
          "item_ref_count": 5,
          "recipe_ref_count": 1,
          "count": 4
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/surviving_mars/better_fuel",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/surviving_mars/better_fuel.json",
          "text": "It's created by collecting ice shards, which are found as an ore underground on cold planets. The ice shard then needs to be inserted into a Cryo Freezer, and it will convert to 25 mB of Cryo Fuel. Alternatively, you can convert ice, packed ice and blue ice to fuel. Once you've made at least two buckets (one for a launch and the other for a return trip), place the buckets in the rocket fuel slot.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.1.text",
          "label": "Better Fuel",
          "item_ref_count": 5,
          "recipe_ref_count": 1,
          "count": 4
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/surviving_mars/better_fuel",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/surviving_mars/better_fuel.json",
          "text": "Cryo Fuel",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.3.title",
          "label": "Better Fuel",
          "item_ref_count": 5,
          "recipe_ref_count": 1,
          "count": 4
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/surviving_mars/better_fuel",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/surviving_mars/better_fuel.json",
          "text": "In addition to being an excellent fuel, cryo fuel has some other features. When placed, it will damage anything inside, similar to lava. It also freezes water, allowing for an infinite ice source.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.3.text",
          "label": "Better Fuel",
          "item_ref_count": 5,
          "recipe_ref_count": 1,
          "count": 4
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/surviving_mars/detection",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/surviving_mars/detection.json",
          "text": "Oxygen Sensor",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.0.title",
          "label": "Detection",
          "item_ref_count": 3,
          "recipe_ref_count": 1,
          "count": 2
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/surviving_mars/detection",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/surviving_mars/detection.json",
          "text": "The oxygen sensor is a block that will emit a redstone signal when it detects oxygen. You can shift-right-click it to invert the signal. Despite its name, you can also change its detection type by right-clicking with a wrench. It has the option to detect oxygen, safe temperature, and normal gravity.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.0.text",
          "label": "Detection",
          "item_ref_count": 3,
          "recipe_ref_count": 1,
          "count": 2
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/surviving_mars/energizer",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/surviving_mars/energizer.json",
          "text": "The energizer is a machine capable of powering items and storing large amounts of energy. To charge an item, power the energizer and then right-click on the energizer with that item. It stores 2 million energy, making it capable of charging machines for a very long time. It also retains its energy when broken.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.0.text",
          "label": "Energizer",
          "item_ref_count": 3,
          "recipe_ref_count": 1,
          "count": 2
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/surviving_mars/flags",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/surviving_mars/flags.json",
          "text": "Flags are decorative blocks available in 16 colors. By default, when placed, they will display the face of the flag owner. They can be configured to display a custom image from a URL by right-clicking and entering the URL in the GUI. This will display the internet image onto the flag.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.0.text",
          "label": "Flags",
          "item_ref_count": 5,
          "recipe_ref_count": 1,
          "count": 2
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/surviving_mars/fluid_pipes",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/surviving_mars/fluid_pipes.json",
          "text": "Fluid Pipes",
          "key": "guide-page:name",
          "label": "Fluid Pipes",
          "item_ref_count": 4,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 4
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/surviving_mars/fluid_pipes",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/surviving_mars/fluid_pipes.json",
          "text": "Fluid Pipes",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.0.title",
          "label": "Fluid Pipes",
          "item_ref_count": 4,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 4
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/surviving_mars/fluid_pipes",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/surviving_mars/fluid_pipes.json",
          "text": "Fluid pipes are similar to cables but with fluid transfer instead of energy transfer. To use them, craft some fluid pipes and a wrench. Then, right-click on one of the pipes with the wrench to cycle through the pipe's modes: 'none,' 'normal,' 'insert,' and 'extract.'",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.0.text",
          "label": "Fluid Pipes",
          "item_ref_count": 4,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 4
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/surviving_mars/fluid_pipes",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/surviving_mars/fluid_pipes.json",
          "text": "Pipes with 'insert' set will receive fluid from the network, while pipes with 'extract' set will pump fluid into the network.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.1.text",
          "label": "Fluid Pipes",
          "item_ref_count": 4,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 4
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/surviving_mars/fluid_pipes",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/surviving_mars/fluid_pipes.json",
          "text": "Like cables, fluid pipes also have a duct block for transfering fluids safely in and out of sealed structures.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.3.text",
          "label": "Fluid Pipes",
          "item_ref_count": 4,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 4
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/surviving_mars/industrial_lamps",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/surviving_mars/industrial_lamps.json",
          "text": "Industrial Lamps",
          "key": "guide-page:name",
          "label": "Industrial Lamps",
          "item_ref_count": 6,
          "recipe_ref_count": 1,
          "count": 2
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/surviving_mars/industrial_lamps",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/surviving_mars/industrial_lamps.json",
          "text": "Industrial Lamps",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.0.title",
          "label": "Industrial Lamps",
          "item_ref_count": 6,
          "recipe_ref_count": 1,
          "count": 2
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/surviving_mars/industrial_lamps",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/surviving_mars/industrial_lamps.json",
          "text": "Industrial lamps are available in all 16 colors, and in small and large sizes. By default, these will all emit normal white light; however, if you have Shimmer, each light will emit its respective color.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.0.text",
          "label": "Industrial Lamps",
          "item_ref_count": 6,
          "recipe_ref_count": 1,
          "count": 2
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/surviving_mars/netherite_space_suit",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/surviving_mars/netherite_space_suit.json",
          "text": "Netherite Space Suit",
          "key": "guide-page:name",
          "label": "Netherite Space Suit",
          "item_ref_count": 5,
          "recipe_ref_count": 2,
          "count": 3
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/surviving_mars/netherite_space_suit",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/surviving_mars/netherite_space_suit.json",
          "text": "Netherite Space Suit",

          "text": "The netherite space suit is an upgraded version of the standard space suit, featuring permanent fire resistance, more protection and the ability to survive on Venus and Mercury.           "key": "guide-page:pages.0.text",

        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/surviving_mars/sliding_doors",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/surviving_mars/sliding_doors.json",
          "text": "Sliding doors are large 3x3 doors. They seal oxygen when closed, making them great candidates for airlocks. They can be locked by shift-right-clicking them with a wrench. Locked doors can only be opened with redstone.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.0.text",
          "label": "Sliding Doors",
          "item_ref_count": 6,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 4
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/creating_plates",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/creating_plates.json",
          "text": "Creating Plates",
          "key": "guide-page:name",
          "label": "Creating Plates",
          "item_ref_count": 3,
          "recipe_ref_count": 1,
          "count": 2
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/creating_plates",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/creating_plates.json",
          "text": "Once you've got energy, you'll want to craft a compressor. This machine can compress ingots and blocks into plates, which are needed to craft many things.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.0.text",
          "label": "Creating Plates",
          "item_ref_count": 3,
          "recipe_ref_count": 1,
          "count": 2
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/fuel",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/fuel.json",
          "text": "Even after you place your rocket, you will not be able to fly just yet. To fly, you will need to fill the rocket with fuel.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.0.text",
          "label": "Fuel",
          "item_ref_count": 6,
          "recipe_ref_count": 1,
          "count": 4
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/fuel",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/fuel.json",
          "text": "Obtaining Fuel",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.1.title",
          "label": "Fuel",
          "item_ref_count": 6,
          "recipe_ref_count": 1,
          "count": 4
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/fuel",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/fuel.json",
          "text": "Oil is found in large amounts spouting over the ocean surface. Collect as much oil as you can, as oil is non-renewable, and you need a lot of it for each rocket launch.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.1.text",
          "label": "Fuel",
          "item_ref_count": 6,
          "recipe_ref_count": 1,
          "count": 4
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/fuel",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/fuel.json",
          "text": "Obtaining Fuel",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.2.title",
          "label": "Fuel",
          "item_ref_count": 6,
          "recipe_ref_count": 1,
          "count": 4
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/fuel",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/fuel.json",
          "text": "After collecting enough oil (at least six buckets for a launch and return), you will need to refine the oil into fuel. To do this, you will need to craft a fuel refinery. Power it, then place the oil in the left slot, and it will be refined into fuel.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.2.text",
          "label": "Fuel",

          "recipe_ref_count": 1,

        {

          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/fuel.json",
          "text": "Shift-click on the rocket to open its inventory, then place three buckets of fuel into the input slot. Place the other three buckets into the rocket's inventory for a return trip.",
