      "semantic_evidence": [
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/getting_started/finding_ores",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/getting_started/finding_ores.json",
          "text": "Ores, Metal, and Casting",
          "key": "guide-page:name",
          "label": "Ores, Metal, and Casting",
          "item_ref_count": 23,
          "recipe_ref_count": 2,
          "count": 13
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/getting_started/finding_ores",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/getting_started/finding_ores.json",
          "text": "In addition to sticks, twigs, and stones on the ground, in your travels you may encounter small pieces of ores scattered around the ground. These are important, as they are one of the only sources of ore and metal before obtaining a pickaxe.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.0.text",
          "label": "Ores, Metal, and Casting",
          "item_ref_count": 23,
          "recipe_ref_count": 2,
          "count": 13
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/getting_started/finding_ores",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/getting_started/finding_ores.json",
          "text": "All small ore pieces",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.1.text",
          "label": "Ores, Metal, and Casting",
          "item_ref_count": 23,
          "recipe_ref_count": 2,
          "count": 13
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/getting_started/finding_ores",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/getting_started/finding_ores.json",
          "text": "These small ore pieces can serve two purposes: they can provide a source of metal, and more importantly, they indicate the presence of a larger vein of ore somewhere nearby, probably underground and close to the surface. Be sure to note where you find small ores, as the location of ore veins will be useful later during Prospecting. The twelve types of small ores, and the metal they can be melted into are listed on the next page.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.2.text",
          "label": "Ores, Metal, and Casting",
          "item_ref_count": 23,
          "recipe_ref_count": 2,
          "count": 13
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/getting_started/finding_ores",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/getting_started/finding_ores.json",
          "text": "- Native Copper (Copper) - Native Gold (Gold) - Hematite (Cast Iron) - Native Silver (Silver) - Cassiterite (Tin) - Bismuthinite (Bismuth) - Garnierite (Nickel) - Malachite (Copper) - Magnetite (Cast Iron) - Limonite (Cast Iron) - Sphalerite (Zinc) - Tetrahedrite (Copper)",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.3.text",
          "label": "Ores, Metal, and Casting",
          "item_ref_count": 23,
          "recipe_ref_count": 2,
          "count": 13
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/getting_started/finding_ores",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/getting_started/finding_ores.json",
          "text": "Small Ores",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.3.title",
          "label": "Ores, Metal, and Casting",
          "item_ref_count": 23,
          "recipe_ref_count": 2,
          "count": 13
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/getting_started/finding_ores",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/getting_started/finding_ores.json",
          "text": "In TerraFirmaCraft, ores each contain a certain number of units, or mB (millibuckets) of actual metal which can be extracted. Small ores like this found on the surface are the lowest quality, and only provide 16 mB of metal. In order to extract this metal, it needs to be melted, and made into tools using a process called casting.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.4.text",
          "label": "Ores, Metal, and Casting",
          "item_ref_count": 23,
          "recipe_ref_count": 2,
          "count": 13
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/getting_started/finding_ores",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/getting_started/finding_ores.json",
          "text": "You will need: - A Small Vessel - Enough materials for a Pit Kiln. - One or more Mold(s) to cast the molten metal. - And finally, at least 144 mB total of a metal which is suitable for casting: Copper, in one or more of its three ore forms. Note: Casting can also be done with some Alloys",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.5.text",
          "label": "Ores, Metal, and Casting",
          "item_ref_count": 23,
          "recipe_ref_count": 2,
          "count": 13
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/getting_started/finding_ores",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/getting_started/finding_ores.json",
          "text": "First, open the Small Vessel and put the ores inside. Count up the total amount of metal in the ores carefully! The vessel can only hold up to 3024mB of molten metal, excess will be lost. Then, you need to build a Pit Kiln with the filled small vessel inside. As the vessel heats, the ores inside it will melt, and you'll be left with a vessel of molten metal.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.6.text",
          "label": "Ores, Metal, and Casting",
          "item_ref_count": 23,
          "recipe_ref_count": 2,
          "count": 13
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/getting_started/finding_ores",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/getting_started/finding_ores.json",
          "text": "Careful, the vessel will be hot! Craft Wooden Tongs with two sticks and a knife and hold them in your off hand to handle the hot vessel safely.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.7.text",
          "label": "Ores, Metal, and Casting",
          "item_ref_count": 23,
          "recipe_ref_count": 2,
          "count": 13
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/getting_started/finding_ores",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/getting_started/finding_ores.json",
          "text": "Hold the vessel and to open the Casting interface.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.8.text",
          "label": "Ores, Metal, and Casting",
          "item_ref_count": 23,
          "recipe_ref_count": 2,
          "count": 13
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/getting_started/finding_ores",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/getting_started/finding_ores.json",
          "text": "With the casting interface open, place your empty fired mold in the center slot. It will fill up as long as the vessel remains liquid. (If the vessel solidifies, it can be reheated in another pit kiln.) Once the mold is full, it can be removed and left to cool. Once cool, the mold and its contents can be extracted by using the mold, or putting it in the crafting grid.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.9.text",
          "label": "Ores, Metal, and Casting",
          "item_ref_count": 23,
          "recipe_ref_count": 2,
          "count": 13
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/getting_started/finding_ores",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/getting_started/finding_ores.json",
          "text": "You are now able to craft your first pickaxe! Find enough copper to make a pickaxe head, fire a pickaxe mold and melt the ore using a pit kiln, then cast a head. Slap it on a stick, and voila! You can now dig for ore.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.10.text",
          "label": "Ores, Metal, and Casting",
          "item_ref_count": 23,
          "recipe_ref_count": 2,
          "count": 13
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/getting_started/finding_ores",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/getting_started/finding_ores.json",
          "text": "A couple other important metal tools are available for progression as well. The Chisel is useful for working with stone blocks for building and other recipes.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.11.text",
          "label": "Ores, Metal, and Casting",
          "item_ref_count": 23,
          "recipe_ref_count": 2,
          "count": 13
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/getting_started/finding_ores",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/getting_started/finding_ores.json",
          "text": "The saw allows you turn wood logs into support beams and lumber, which can further be crafted into planks, the crafting bench, barrels, and chests, among other things. It is also useful to make a canoe.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.12.text",
          "label": "Ores, Metal, and Casting",
          "item_ref_count": 23,
          "recipe_ref_count": 2,
          "count": 13
        },

        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/getting_started/finding_ores",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/getting_started/finding_ores.json",
          "text": "In TerraFirmaCraft, ores each contain a certain number of units, or mB (millibuckets) of actual metal which can be extracted. Small ores like this found on the surface are the lowest quality, and only provide 16 mB of metal. In order to extract this metal, it needs to be melted, and made into tools using a process called casting.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.4.text",
          "label": "Ores, Metal, and Casting",
          "item_ref_count": 23,
          "recipe_ref_count": 2,
          "count": 13
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/getting_started/finding_ores",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/getting_started/finding_ores.json",
          "text": "You will need: - A Small Vessel - Enough materials for a Pit Kiln. - One or more Mold(s) to cast the molten metal. - And finally, at least 144 mB total of a metal which is suitable for casting: Copper, in one or more of its three ore forms. Note: Casting can also be done with some Alloys",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.5.text",
          "label": "Ores, Metal, and Casting",
          "item_ref_count": 23,
          "recipe_ref_count": 2,
          "count": 13
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/getting_started/finding_ores",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/getting_started/finding_ores.json",
          "text": "First, open the Small Vessel and put the ores inside. Count up the total amount of metal in the ores carefully! The vessel can only hold up to 3024mB of molten metal, excess will be lost. Then, you need to build a Pit Kiln with the filled small vessel inside. As the vessel heats, the ores inside it will melt, and you'll be left with a vessel of molten metal.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.6.text",
          "label": "Ores, Metal, and Casting",
          "item_ref_count": 23,
          "recipe_ref_count": 2,
          "count": 13
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/getting_started/finding_ores",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/getting_started/finding_ores.json",
          "text": "Careful, the vessel will be hot! Craft Wooden Tongs with two sticks and a knife and hold them in your off hand to handle the hot vessel safely.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.7.text",
          "label": "Ores, Metal, and Casting",
          "item_ref_count": 23,
          "recipe_ref_count": 2,
          "count": 13
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/getting_started/finding_ores",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/getting_started/finding_ores.json",
          "text": "Hold the vessel and to open the Casting interface.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.8.text",
          "label": "Ores, Metal, and Casting",
          "item_ref_count": 23,
          "recipe_ref_count": 2,
          "count": 13
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/getting_started/finding_ores",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/getting_started/finding_ores.json",
          "text": "With the casting interface open, place your empty fired mold in the center slot. It will fill up as long as the vessel remains liquid. (If the vessel solidifies, it can be reheated in another pit kiln.) Once the mold is full, it can be removed and left to cool. Once cool, the mold and its contents can be extracted by using the mold, or putting it in the crafting grid.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.9.text",
          "label": "Ores, Metal, and Casting",
          "item_ref_count": 23,
          "recipe_ref_count": 2,
          "count": 13
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/getting_started/finding_ores",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/getting_started/finding_ores.json",
          "text": "You are now able to craft your first pickaxe! Find enough copper to make a pickaxe head, fire a pickaxe mold and melt the ore using a pit kiln, then cast a head. Slap it on a stick, and voila! You can now dig for ore.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.10.text",
          "label": "Ores, Metal, and Casting",
          "item_ref_count": 23,
          "recipe_ref_count": 2,
          "count": 13
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/getting_started/finding_ores",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/getting_started/finding_ores.json",
          "text": "A couple other important metal tools are available for progression as well. The Chisel is useful for working with stone blocks for building and other recipes.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.11.text",
          "label": "Ores, Metal, and Casting",
          "item_ref_count": 23,
          "recipe_ref_count": 2,
          "count": 13
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/getting_started/finding_ores",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/getting_started/finding_ores.json",
          "text": "The saw allows you turn wood logs into support beams and lumber, which can further be crafted into planks, the crafting bench, barrels, and chests, among other things. It is also useful to make a canoe.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.12.text",
          "label": "Ores, Metal, and Casting",
          "item_ref_count": 23,
          "recipe_ref_count": 2,
          "count": 13
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questsstoneage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questsstoneage.snbt",
          "text": "As you begin your journey, the first thing you'll notice is a completely changed world. You can no longer break trees with your fists, but fret not, for any caveman is not a real caveman without his stone tools!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "As you begin your journey, the first thing you'll notice is a completely changed world. You can no longer break trees with your fists, but fret not, for any caveman is not a real caveman without his stone tools!",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },

          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questsstoneage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questsstoneage.snbt",
          "text": "Instead of crafting a wooden pickaxe, you can just pick up rocks from the ground. Begin by collecting at least 4 rocks. You can collect rocks by breaking or right-clicking them with an empty hand.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "As you begin your journey, the first thing you'll notice is a completely changed world. You can no longer break trees with your fists, but fret not, for any caveman is not a real caveman without his stone tools!",

          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "As you begin your journey, the first thing you'll notice is a completely changed world. You can no longer break trees with your fists, but fret not, for any caveman is not a real caveman without his stone tools!",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questsstoneage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questsstoneage.snbt",
          "text": "Thirst is represented by the blue bar above your hunger. You can and will die of dehydration if you dont keep your thirst meter filled! The easiest way to have a drink is by drinking from natural ponds in the wild, by right-clicking on them with an empty hand.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "As you begin your journey, the first thing you'll notice is a completely changed world. You can no longer break trees with your fists, but fret not, for any caveman is not a real caveman without his stone tools!",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questsstoneage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questsstoneage.snbt",
          "text": "To complete this quest, you need to drink a Potable source of water, can be regular or river water. You may need to drink multiple times so the quest completes properly",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "As you begin your journey, the first thing you'll notice is a completely changed world. You can no longer break trees with your fists, but fret not, for any caveman is not a real caveman without his stone tools!",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {

          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questsstoneage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questsstoneage.snbt",
          "text": "You don't have to worry about purifying water here, though Salt Water will just make you more thirsty.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "As you begin your journey, the first thing you'll notice is a completely changed world. You can no longer break trees with your fists, but fret not, for any caveman is not a real caveman without his stone tools!",
          "item_ref_count": 32

          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questsstoneage.snbt",
          "text": "Remember to drink water!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "As you begin your journey, the first thing you'll notice is a completely changed world. You can no longer break trees with your fists, but fret not, for any caveman is not a real caveman without his stone tools!",

          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questsstoneage.snbt",

          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "As you begin your journey, the first thing you'll notice is a completely changed world. You can no longer break trees with your fists, but fret not, for any caveman is not a real caveman without his stone tools!",

          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questsstoneage.snbt",

          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "As you begin your journey, the first thing you'll notice is a completely changed world. You can no longer break trees with your fists, but fret not, for any caveman is not a real caveman without his stone tools!",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questsstoneage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questsstoneage.snbt",
          "text": "Another abundant item on the ground are sticks, which have many uses! They can create tools, torches, firestarters and more.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "As you begin your journey, the first thing you'll notice is a completely changed world. You can no longer break trees with your fists, but fret not, for any caveman is not a real caveman without his stone tools!",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questsstoneage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questsstoneage.snbt",
          "text": "To avoid having your inventory get clogged with different types of sticks, you can craft them into 'regular' sticks to stack them together. Later, you can bundle nine sticks into a Bunch, and the Bunch into a Bundle, which can then be used as a substitute for logs.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "As you begin your journey, the first thing you'll notice is a completely changed world. You can no longer break trees with your fists, but fret not, for any caveman is not a real caveman without his stone tools!",

        {

          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "As you begin your journey, the first thing you'll notice is a completely changed world. You can no longer break trees with your fists, but fret not, for any caveman is not a real caveman without his stone tools!",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questsstoneage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questsstoneage.snbt",
          "text": "While stone and flint are relatively simple and primitive materials, they're what you're stuck with until you learn how to work with metals. Some other useful tools include the Javelin, which can be thrown like a vanilla Trident, and the Hoe, which allows you to farm.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "As you begin your journey, the first thing you'll notice is a completely changed world. You can no longer break trees with your fists, but fret not, for any caveman is not a real caveman without his stone tools!",

          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questsstoneage.snbt",
          "text": "Turns out hitting stones together is quite useful",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "As you begin your journey, the first thing you'll notice is a completely changed world. You can no longer break trees with your fists, but fret not, for any caveman is not a real caveman without his stone tools!",

          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questsstoneage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questsstoneage.snbt",
          "text": "With your new Stone Axe, you'll be able to chop down trees. Breaking the base of a tree causes the entire tree to fall down, resulting in logs, sticks, and saplings.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "As you begin your journey, the first thing you'll notice is a completely changed world. You can no longer break trees with your fists, but fret not, for any caveman is not a real caveman without his stone tools!",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },

          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questsstoneage.snbt",
          "text": "Gather at least 10 logs -- 8 of these will be used for a Pit Kiln while the other two will be used for a Fire Pit.",

          "label": "As you begin your journey, the first thing you'll notice is a completely changed world. You can no longer break trees with your fists, but fret not, for any caveman is not a real caveman without his stone tools!",

        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questsstoneage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questsstoneage.snbt",
          "text": "Congratulations! With your Workbench you've officially entered the Peak of the Stone Age. With it you'll be able to craft a multitude of new things with the items you've gathered so far.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "As you begin your journey, the first thing you'll notice is a completely changed world. You can no longer break trees with your fists, but fret not, for any caveman is not a real caveman without his stone tools!",

        },

          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questsstoneage.snbt",
